callout.text: LIVE since Wed 4 Nov 6:00 AM local: Giratina (Altered) 5★ → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM (Raid Hour tonight Wed 4 Nov 6–7 PM) + Shadow Tornadus (Incarnate) 5★ weekends (first window → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM; longer package Mon 16 Nov → Tue 1 Dec). Shadow 1★ (Gastly / Totodile / Shieldon / Gible) + Shadow 3★ (Primeape / Kirlia / Drapion) still listed on GO Hub / Halloween Part II guides with the Tornadus rotation. Still LIVE: Halloween 2026 Part II costume 1★ Pikachu (hat+capelet) + Sinistea (bow) → Thu 5 Nov 8:00 PM; Mega Sableye → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM. ENDED Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM: Origin Giratina 5★ + Origin-window 3★ (Cofagrigus / Trevenant / Dhelmise) + Shadow Landorus package. No new standard 3★ posted yet (Leek Duck raid-bosses page still stale on Origin) — omitted, not invented. Eggs (Leek Duck Updated Sep 14) / Rocket (Updated Oct 2; Giovanni inactive for new radars) unchanged.
callout.endsAtLabel: Giratina (Altered) + Shadow Tornadus first window → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM · Raid Hour Wed 4 Nov 6–7 PM · Halloween Part II / costume 1★ → Thu 5 Nov 8:00 PM · Mega Sableye → Sun 8 Nov 10:00 PM · Origin / ghosty 3★ / Shadow Landorus ENDED Tue 3 Nov 10:00 PM
